_doc.purpose: The area names Malmö actually uses that no dataset has. Hand-edited; build-neighbourhoods.mjs only validates, places and resolves — it never invents an entry or rewrites your groupings.
why: Two official divisions exist and neither says what people say. The ten stadsdelar are too coarse (Västra Innerstaden) and the 136 delområden too fine (Ribersborg, Rönneholm, Kronprinsen) — the name in between, Slottsstaden, is in no dataset at all. Same for Limhamn, Hamnen, Sofielund, and for the small named quarters like Fullriggaren.
So this file holds the two ends the official data misses: groupings of delområden, and parts of one.

kinds.grouping: Has `covers`: the delområden it is made of, by exact name. Drawn at the neighbourhood level, where it replaces its members. Its shape is those polygons, so it needs no geometry of its own.
kinds.part: Has `within`: the delområde it sits inside, and a point. Drawn at the deepest zoom, below the delområde level. Smaller than any official area, so there is nothing to derive it from — the point is resolved once from Nominatim and then checked by hand.

_doc.oneMember: A grouping may cover a single delområde. That is not a grouping but a promotion: a claim that the name is used for the *place* and not merely for the statistical unit, so it belongs on the in-between level too. The bar is deliberately high, because promoting all 136 is the mistake this level exists to avoid — the name must be one you would answer "var bor du?" with, and it must be carried by a source outside the delområde register: Malmö stad's own områden pages, place=suburb in OSM, a Skånetrafiken stop, a tätort in its own right, or estate agents selling by that name. Västra Hamnen and Gamla Staden pass; Ribersborg and Hyllievång do not. Malmö stad's own områden list is the strongest of those sources and has now been mined to the end: every name on it is either a grouping here or a promotion, except the three village sites (Bulltofta by, Käglinge bytomt, Skvalperup) whose names are not the delområde's.
_doc.narrowerThanTheStadsdel: Five level-3 names repeat the stadsdel above them over a smaller area: Hyllie, Rosengård, Oxie, Kirseberg, Husie. This was refused at first — one word for two extents at two zooms — and then allowed, because the alternative was leaving the six largest holes in the level over exactly the parts of Malmö people name most confidently. The extent is not guessed in any of them: it is where OSM's own place=suburb node for the name falls, plus every Skånetrafiken stop carrying the name, by point-in-polygon. Where those disagree with the stadsdel they disagree sharply and usefully — eleven stops called Hyllie all land in Hyllievång, none anywhere else in the stadsdel Hyllie. test/areas.test.mjs allows exactly these five by name and still fails on a sixth.

rejected.why: Kept so the same candidates are not re-researched. See DECISIONS.md for the long version.
rejected.Fosie: The sixth stadsdel name, and the one that cannot be narrowed: its core is already spoken for. OSM's Fosie suburb node lands in Gullviksborg, which the Gullvik grouping holds, and the stops named for it scatter across Fosieby, Kastanjegården, Lindängen (Fosie kyrka), Holma (Fosiedal) and Lindeborg (Fosieborg) — Fosieby, the village and church the name comes from, is already a grouping. Adding Fosie would mean taking delområden away from Fosieby or Gullvik to spell a name those two already cover.
rejected.Västra Förstaden, Mellersta Förstaden, S: Malmö's historic in-between division, and exactly the right grain (Västra Förstaden = Fridhem + Mellanheden + Västervång). Rejected because Wikipedia has all five in the past tense and nobody says them, and because they predate the stadsdelar and cross them — Östra Förstaden spans Centrum and Kirseberg, Mellersta Förstaden four stadsdelar.
rejected.Bunkeflo: Half of the stadsdel name Limhamn-Bunkeflo and plainly a real name, but no source found that says where it stops — the Wikipedia page is a disambiguation for the socken, församling and by. Needs an owner call, not a source.
rejected.Backarna: The local name for Kirseberg. Slang, and it would put a nickname at one zoom and Kirseberg at another.
rejected.Triangeln: Proposed as the name for Rådmansvången, and refused as a landmark rather than an area. Malmö stad files it under Malmös torg, not under stadsdelar och områden — a knutpunkt that 'har i mer än hundra år kallats Triangeln'. Wikipedia: 'en öppen plats i centrala Malmö, belägen där delområdena Davidshall, Rådmansvången och Lugnet möts', so it is centred on the corner where three delområden meet and has no extent to lend to any one of them. MKB markets Rådmansvången itself as a bostadsområde — 'med Pildammsvägen i väst och Bergsgatan i öst och mellan Sjukhusområdet och Triangeln' — which puts Rådmansvången next to Triangeln, not inside it. Hemnet sells flats under both names over the same streets; that is a second label, not a replacement. See areas/elevated.md.

fields.name: As it is said and as it will be shown.
fields.covers: Grouping only. Exact delområde names; the build fails on a typo.
fields.partial: Members the area only takes a piece of. Listed in the card, and drawn whole — over-covering an edge is more honest than a hole in the middle.
fields.within: Part only. The delområde it is inside.
fields.narrowerThanStadsdel: Grouping only, and rare. The stadsdel whose name this one repeats over less ground — see _doc.narrowerThanTheStadsdel. Naming it here is what licenses the repeat; the test fails on any other name that appears twice.
fields.source: Where the extent came from. Every grouping has one; that is the point.
fields.note: Anything the source left open — read these before trusting an extent.
fields.lat/lon: Parts only, filled by the resolver. Edit freely.
fields.verified: Set true once you have looked at it on the map and agree with the extent. Everything below is false: it was assembled from sources, not from living here.

workflow: 2. node scripts/build-neighbourhoods.mjs --resolve   (fills missing points for parts)
3. Look at each area on the map; fix `covers` where it is wrong; set "verified": true.

areas.name: Slottsstaden
areas.note: Wikipedia: 'motsvarar ungefär delområdena Ribersborg, Malmöhus (sydvästra delen, Slottsparken), Hästhagen, Kronprinsen, Fågelbacken (norra delen) och Rönneholm (norra delen)'. The three partials are taken whole here.

areas.name: Limhamn
areas.note: The old town, the harbour and the quarry, plus the eastern edge. That edge was left out at first as a matter of local usage with no source behind it; the owner's call is that it belongs, and Malmö stad's own statistics agree — Annetorp, Djupadal and Rosenvång sit in statistikområde 6 with Gamla Limhamn and Sibbarp. Hyllieby is in that område too but stays out: its name points at Hyllie.

areas.name: Hamnen
areas.note: Malmö stad lists 'Malmö hamn' as one area. Västra Hamnen is deliberately excluded — it is its own place now, and is named separately on the map.

areas.name: Sofielund
areas.note: Split into Norra and Södra by the Malmö–Ystad railway in 1874; still one name in speech.

areas.name: Bellevue
areas.note: Bellevuegården was in this at first, on the strength of the shared word alone, and is now out: it is in the stadsdel Hyllie next to Lorensborg while these two are in Limhamn-Bunkeflo, 1.2 km away, and Malmö stad counts it to a different statistikområde (8, not 7). A sixties estate that borrowed the villa district's name. It stands on its own at level 3 now. The two that are left are adjacent, in one stadsdel and one statistikområde — but the source here is still only the names, so this extent wants a real one before "verified".

areas.name: Stadionområdet
areas.source: vardagligt namn; delområdet heter bara Stadion
areas.note: One member — this is a renaming, not a grouping: the area is spoken of as Stadionområdet.

areas.name: Västra Hamnen
areas.note: A promotion (see _doc.oneMember): Malmö stad gives Västra hamnen its own page among the city's områden, OSM tags it place=suburb, and it is a district in its own right rather than a statistical unit. Hamnen, next door, excludes it for the same reason — so without this entry the one part of the harbour everyone can name was the only part with no name at this level.

areas.name: Gamla Staden
areas.note: A promotion: 'Gamla staden består av Malmös medeltida stadskärna och Nya staden' — the canals on three sides and Slottsgatan on the fourth, which is what 'stan' means when said here. Centrum, the word people also use, is taken by the stadsdel above it, so this is the name the level can carry.

areas.name: Möllevången
areas.note: A promotion: 'Möllevången (i folkmun Möllan) är en stadsdel i Malmö kring Möllevångstorget och Folkets Park' — Wikipedia calls it a stadsdel, OSM tags it place=suburb, and the delområde boundary is the extent everyone means. Lönngården and Annelund are left out: they are next to Möllan, not in it.

areas.name: Bunkeflostrand
areas.note: A promotion: 'en tätort och ett delområde i Malmö kommun' — 15 500 people in a locality of its own, with its own Hemnet market and eleven Skånetrafiken stops carrying the name. Annestad and Strandhem sit inside it as parts.

areas.name: Klagshamn
areas.note: A promotion: Malmö stad gives it its own områdespage — 'växte fram kring kalkbrytning och cementindustri … från industrisamhälle till ett populärt bostads- och rekreationsområde'. A place on the coast with six stops named after it, not a statistical unit. Skumparp is left out; no source puts it in Klagshamn.

areas.name: Lorensborg
areas.note: A promotion, and the city's own word for it: 'Lorensborg ligger i Malmös västra del.' One of the four names still left on Malmö stad's områden list once the groupings had taken theirs — the same list Hamnen, Sorgenfri, Sofielund and Söderkulla come from.

areas.name: Kulladal
areas.note: A promotion, from Malmö stad's områden list: 'utvecklats från åkermark och bymiljö till ett tätbebyggt bostadsområde' with ties to Per Albin Hansson, whose home stands here — the Per Albins hem stop is in Kulladal.

areas.name: Augustenborg
areas.note: A promotion, from Malmö stad's områden list: 'Augustenborg är ett bostadsområde i Malmö.'

areas.name: Davidshall
areas.note: A promotion, from Malmö stad's områden list: 'Davidshall är en stadsdel i Malmös innerstad med bostäder, affärer, restauranger, busslinjer, torg och gator.' Also place=suburb in OSM, with a torg of its own.

areas.name: Fridhem
areas.note: A promotion, and the first of the three names between Slottsstaden and Bellevue. Wikipedia: 'ett delområde inom stadsdelen Västra Innerstaden … var tidigare en egen stadsdel', 43 ha 'innanför Ribersborgsstranden, mellan Köpenhamnsvägen och Ribersborgsvägen'. A former stadsdel, place=suburb in OSM, and a torg named after it. Erikslust sits on its eastern edge and is kept as a part, not folded in.

areas.name: Mellanheden
areas.note: A promotion, the second of the three. Wikipedia describes it as a bostadsområde 'mellan Erikslustvägen och Bellevuevägen, norr om Mellanhedsgatan' — villas from the 1920s and flats from the 1950s to Gunnar Lindman's plan. place=suburb in OSM, four stops carrying the name.

areas.name: Västervång
areas.source: place=suburb i OSM (node inside the delområde); Skånetrafiken 'Västervång'
areas.note: A promotion, the third of the three — and the thinnest source of any of them: no Wikipedia article of its own and no page from the city, just OSM's suburb node and two stops. Kept because leaving it out would put a hole between Mellanheden and Bellevue for no reason a source gives. First one to cut if the level starts feeling crowded.

areas.name: Hyllie
areas.source: place=suburb i OSM; 11 Skånetrafiken-hållplatser 'Hyllie' + Hyllie Allé, Hyllie Vattenpark, Hyllievångsparken, Hylliebadet, Hyllierankan
areas.note: Every one of them lands in Hyllievång — the station, Emporia, arenan, badet. The stadsdel Hyllie is five times larger and reaches Lorensborg and Kulladal; what anyone means by 'Hyllie' is this. Hyllie gård and Hyllie kyrkoväg fall the other way, into Hyllieby and Annetorp: those are the old village the new district took the name from.

areas.name: Rosengård
areas.source: place=suburb i OSM (in Rosengård Centrum); Skånetrafiken 'Rosengård', 'Rosengård Centrum', 'Rosengårds station'
areas.note: The estate as it is spoken of: the five gårdar and the centre. The stadsdel Rosengård also takes Persborg, Västra Kattarp, Emilstorp and Östra Kyrkogården — a cemetery and three areas with names of their own that nobody files under Rosengård. All six are inside statistikområde 10, so the city's statistics group them this way too.

areas.name: Oxie
areas.source: Skånetrafiken: 21 stops prefixed 'Oxie' (Oxie Centrum, Oxie kyrka, Oxie station, Oxie Kungshögsskolan…), all landing in Oxie Kyrkby or Oxievång
areas.note: The tätort, not the stadsdel. The stadsdel Oxie also holds Käglinge, Lockarp, Glostorp, Toarp and Kristineberg — villages and a housing area that are named for themselves and have their own stops ('Käglinge …', 'Kristineberg …'), never prefixed Oxie. Kungshög is in because the school on it is served as 'Oxie Kungshögsskolan'.

areas.name: Kirseberg
areas.source: place=suburb i OSM; Skånetrafiken 'Kirsebergs torg', 'Kirsebergs kyrka'
areas.note: The hill itself. Rostorp, Håkanstorp, Johanneslust, Bulltofta and Valdemarsro are in the stadsdel and left out here: each is a name people use, and no stop or OSM object calls any of them Kirseberg. Backarna, the local word for the same ground, is left out too — see _doc.rejected.

areas.name: Husie
areas.source: place=suburb i OSM (in Kvarnby); Skånetrafiken 'Husiegård' (Kvarnby), 'Husie kyrkoväg' (Östra Skrävlinge)
areas.note: The shakiest of the five, and worth your eye before anything else here. OSM and the stops both put Husie at the old village — the church and Husiegård — which is Kvarnby and Östra Skrävlinge. But 'jag bor i Husie' is said out here about Videdal and Riseberga as well, so this extent may be the historic Husie rather than the spoken one. Narrow it to Kvarnby, or widen it, once you have looked.

areas.name: Carolikvarteren
areas.note: 'Carolikvarteren, eller tidigare ofta kvarteren kring Caroli kyrka, är en mindre del av Gamla staden i Malmö' — bounded by Mäster Nilsgatan, Rundelsgatan, Stora Kvarngatan, Norregatan and Östergatan. The eastern half of the old town, as Gamla Väster is the western: the two parts of Gamla Staden that have names of their own. Anchored on the Caroli stop.

areas.name: Erikslust
areas.source: https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erikslust (redirects to Fridhem: 'Vid Erikslust ligger det så kallade Kopparhuset'); Skånetrafiken stop 'Erikslust'
areas.note: Anchored on the Erikslust stop at Erikslustsrondellen, the way Seved is anchored on Sevedsplan. The name has no boundary and straddles three delområden — Erikslustvägen is the old border of Västra Förstaden, with Fridhem and Mellanheden on the far side — so the crossing itself is what is being named. Point-in-polygon puts the stop in Rönneholm.

areas.name: Högaholm
areas.note: No Wikipedia article and no boundary anywhere; sold by name and served by name. The two Högaholm stops sit either side of the Almvik/Lindängen line — this is the northern one.

areas.name: Toftängen
areas.source: https://www.maklarhuset.se/malmo (listed as 'Toftängen - Virentofta - Husie'); Skånetrafiken stop 'Toftängen'
areas.note: Three Toftängen stops fall in three different delområden (Virentofta, Östra Skrävlinge, Kvarnby) within 300 m. Virentofta is the one the estate agent pairs the name with.

areas.name: Annestad
areas.source: place=neighbourhood i OSM (node); Skånetrafiken stop 'Bunkeflostrand Annestad'

areas.name: Strandhem
areas.source: place=neighbourhood i OSM (way); Skånetrafiken stop 'Bunkeflostrand Strandhem'; https://www.alltimalmo.se/allt-om-malmo/stadsomraden/omraden

areas.name: Gyllins trädgård
areas.source: place=neighbourhood i OSM (node); Skånetrafiken stop 'Gyllins trädgård'
areas.note: Built on the Gyllin nursery. New enough that the delområde lines cut across it: the OSM node is in Östra Skrävlinge, the stops in Toftanäs and Riseberga.

areas.name: Vita Höja
areas.note: Höja has no Wikipedia article and neither half has an OSM object, so this point comes from the geocoder — check it before trusting it.
